title: Senior Java Developer
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role About the role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll join a global community of experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely to shape the future of Java modernization. In this position, you will design, build, and maintain high-volume business logic while refactoring legacy code to enable seamless integration with modern cloud and mobile applications. Beyond technical execution, you will bring strong leadership skills to guide and mentor an offshore engineering team over the long term. Key Responsibilities Microservices Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable microservices using Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4. Event Streaming & Kafka: Implement real-time event streaming solutions using Apache Kafka to consume, transform, enrich, and publish streaming data. Data Integration & Persistence: Implement change-detection logic, publish event updates, and optimize data persistence within MySQL databases. Cloud & Resiliency Architecture: Deploy and manage applications on Microsoft Azure PaaS, ensuring fault-tolerant, scalable, and highly available streaming architectures. Reliability & Testing: Configure robust retry mechanisms, dead-letter topics, and idempotent processing while writing comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests. DevOps & Delivery: Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Team Leadership: Mentor and guide an offshore development team to foster technical growth and ensure delivery excellence. Database Management: Proficiency in MySQL database integration, query optimization, and implementing change-data capture/detection patterns. Distributed Systems Reliability: Demonstrated ability to build resilient systems utilizing idempotent processing, fault-tolerant design, retry handling, and dead-letter queues. Your future at Kyndryl This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience Required 10 years+ Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred Qualifications Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Staff Software Engineer- Test
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. About the role We're hiring an SDET-2 (Software Development Engineer in Test) in Bengaluru to own quality for the services our customers depend on. You'll decide what to test and how, build and maintain automation, test by hand where it finds problems fastest, and help the team ship often without breaking customers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 2–5 years in software testing or development. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've built automation that runs in CI. Test suites you designed or substantially extended, that run on every change and that the team trusts. You own quality, not just test cases. You've decided what to test for a feature or release, and stood behind the call. You are comfortable testing by hand. You use manual and exploratory testing deliberately, where it finds problems faster than scripts. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a feature or release, you plan the testing, unblock yourself, and raise risks early. Test plan Breakdown: You can take product requirements and create deep test plan including all corner cases to ensure Quality We care how you test more than which tool you did it in. Technical background You've tested production systems with a modern stack, such as: Languages: strong in at least one language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript — you write test code with the same care as product code. Test automation: frameworks such as Pytest, JUnit/TestNG, Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including structuring a suite so it stays maintainable. APIs and services: contract and integration testing of REST APIs, including error paths, auth and data validation. CI and cloud: running tests in CI pipelines, and testing services deployed on AWS — reading logs and metrics to diagnose failures. Databases: SQL to set up and verify data, and an understanding of how data issues show up as bugs. Non-functional testing: exposure to performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter, k6 or Locust. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Escaped bugs went down, release time went down, or flaky tests went away — and you can say what you did to get there. A suite you made better. You took slow or flaky automation and made it fast and trusted, not just bigger. Framework mindset: You spot repeated test code and turn it into reusable helpers, fixtures or tooling others build on. Root-cause thinking. You trace a failure to its cause in code, data or config, not just report the symptom. Product sense. You've pushed back on a release, or on a requirement that would confuse users, and been right. Lifting others. Test reviews, docs or mentoring that made developers and newer SDETs better at quality. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You test the way customers actually work, and you treat every escaped bug and support ticket as a lesson. Impact over activity. You measure success by bugs that never reached customers and releases that went out smoothly, not test-case counts. Honesty. You report quality as it is, say clearly what wasn't tested, and raise release risks even when it's unwelcome. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to test. You find the risk worth covering and get it done with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built, a technique you went deep on, things you taught others. Depth. At least one system you've tested well enough to explain its internals, its failure modes and how you'd test them. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Sr. Specialist FinTech - Payment Acceptance
description: Company Description Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description ROLE SUMMARY The fintech payments landscape at talabat is complex — high transaction volumes, multiple acquiring partners, evolving scheme rules, and an internal product roadmap that doesn’t always behave as documented. We are looking for a rigorous, detail-obsessed operator who doesn’t take things at face value. When a provider says an issue is resolved, this person goes and confirms it. When a metric moves, they trace it to its root cause. When a product launches a fix, they validate the data before declaring success. This role sits at the intersection of payment performance, commercial analysis, and operational accountability — requiring someone who can work independently, challenge assumptions confidently, and translate deep analytical findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership and external partners. WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Own payment performance analytics end-to-end — not just tracking metrics, but independently diagnosing root causes behind acceptance rate shifts, acquirer-level anomalies, and CPO movements, without relying solely on provider or product-supplied explanations. Validate claims from payment providers, product teams, and processing partners through independent data analysis. Lead deep-dive investigations into payment performance issues and operational gaps — structuring findings clearly for senior director audiences and driving resolution through cross-functional teams. Drive the end-to-end execution of projects, from evaluating feasibility and commercial viability to supporting rollout in partnership with cross-functional teams. Evaluate internal and external opportunities aligned with the fintech strategy, and project manage their execution. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? 3+ years of experience in Strategy, or Operations roles within a tech, e-commerce, or fintech organization. Prior exposure to fintech is a requirement Deep working knowledge of the payments ecosystem — including acquirer processing, issuer decline logic, 3DS authentication flows, scheme rules, and settlement mechanics — sufficient to independently interrogate provider data and identify discrepancies without relying on external guidance. Proficiency in data analysis tools (SQL and/or Excel/Sheets at advanced level, or BI platforms) with the ability to independently build analyses, reconcile datasets, and surface insights without depending on a dedicated analytics function. Strong solution orientation with a high sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency. Collaborative and adaptable, with experience working cross-functionally across product, legal, marketing, fraud, and business operations teams. Ability to lead through influence — driving cross-functional outcomes without direct authority Naturally skeptical and intellectually rigorous — the instinct to question assumptions, trace anomalies to their source, and validate conclusions through data before acting on them. Ability to break down large, complex challenges into structured, executable action plans.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Under summary section Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come! Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions May contribute to code & design reviews Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What you need to know about the role: PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. Meet our team: Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. Your way to impact: As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. This role is for a technically strong problem-solver who can independently diagnose complex issues, run and troubleshoot scripts, install and repair software, and perform system-level cleanup when automated remediation fails. Job Description Provide advanced L2 support for macOS endpoints during 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST business hours. Own complex macOS incidents from initial diagnosis through resolution, user validation, documentation, and closure. Run, review, and troubleshoot Bash, Zsh, Python, or approved administrative scripts used for installation, configuration, remediation, and cleanup. Diagnose failed scripts by checking permissions, dependencies, execution paths, environment variables, logs, exit codes, processes, and file-system state. Install, configure, upgrade, repair, and remove approved applications and command-line tools. Perform controlled cleanup of residual files, packages, binaries, caches, launch items, configuration files, and supporting components when automated scripts fail. Troubleshoot application launch failures, corrupted installations, performance issues, permissions problems, startup issues, and operating-system behavior. Use Terminal and native macOS utilities to investigate issues beyond standard runbooks. Analyze macOS logs and system information to determine root cause and recommend durable fixes. Support users through Slack, Zoom, and the designated ticketing platform while providing clear and timely communication. Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, repeatable fixes, and known errors for future support use. Escalate only when an issue requires specialist engineering, vendor intervention, or access outside the approved L2 support boundary. Qualification 5+ years of hands-on macOS support or administration experience, including at least 3 years in an L2 or advanced endpoint-support role. Strong knowledge of current enterprise macOS environments and the ability to adapt to new macOS releases. Deep understanding of macOS file-system structure, permissions, processes, services, application bundles, installation packages, and configuration locations. Hands-on experience with LaunchAgents, LaunchDaemons, login items, Keychain, FileVault, Disk Utility, Activity Monitor, Console, System Settings, and package installers. Ability to navigate and troubleshoot locations such as /bin, /usr/bin, /usr/local, /etc, /Library, /System, /Applications, and /var. Experience identifying and safely removing residual binaries, support files, caches, plists, packages, and other components after failed installations or removals. Command-Line and Scripting Skills Strong daily working knowledge of macOS Terminal, Bash, and Zsh. Ability to read, execute, interpret, and troubleshoot shell scripts rather than treating scripts as black boxes. Ability to identify why a script failed and perform a controlled manual remediation when appropriate. Experience with common command-line utilities for files, permissions, processes, services, logs, packages, networking, and disk usage. Working knowledge of Python or AppleScript is preferred. Application and Endpoint Support Experience installing and troubleshooting enterprise and developer software on macOS. Ability to diagnose dependency, certificate, package, permission, PATH, architecture, and compatibility issues. Experience supporting approved command-line and productivity tools in a corporate environment. Familiarity with enterprise macOS management platforms such as Jamf Pro, Kandji, or Microsoft Intune is preferred. Preferred Qualifications Apple Certified Support Professional or other relevant Apple certification. Experience supporting executive users, developers, or technically advanced end users. Knowledge of MDM policies, configuration profiles, software deployment, endpoint security controls, and automated remediation. Experience working in Slack-led support environments and maintaining high-quality ITSM records. Exposure to ITIL-aligned incident, request, change, and knowledge-management practices.
